name: Finalize SSD restart
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@clementine.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/nvme11n1/artemisprime/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
cfg=docker-data/data/config.py
echo "remaining_blank=$(grep -c -E '"(multiScreens|charLimit|processLimit)": ""' "$cfg" || true)"
podman stop -t 15 upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman rm upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman pod rm -f upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d upload-assistant-wastaken
sleep 15
podman ps --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}'
code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/ua-health -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:12346/api/health || true)
echo "health_http=$code"
REMOTE
description: Cleanly restart Clementine after applying persistent tracker overrides so the running process loads them.
